tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create an invoice for a business-client transaction. Use when needing a full invoice document. Do NOT use for calculating totals only; use calculate_totals instead.

tools.name: calculate_totals
tools.description: Calculate totals for a list of items. Use when needing subtotal, discount, tax, and total. Do NOT use for creating invoices; use create_invoice instead.

tools.name: supported_currencies
tools.description: List all supported invoice currencies. Use when setting up invoices; NOT for real-time currency conversion. Use calculate_totals for that.

tools.name: render_invoice_text
tools.description: Render an invoice as plain text for emailing. Use when sending invoices via email or text. NOT for generating PDFs; use render_invoice_pdf instead.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_invoice" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Generate a complete invoice (number, dates, totals) from business, client and line items. Nothing stored." → after: "Create an invoice for a business-client transaction. Use when needing a full invoice document. Do NOT use for calculating totals only; use calculate_totals instead."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
